description: This file defines an Angular standalone component 'ItinerariesPageComponent' that manages a user's travel itineraries. It includes a form to create new itineraries, displays a list of existing itineraries with options to edit or delete, and handles loading and error states. The component interacts with 'ItineraryStore' and 'AuthStore' for data management and user authentication.

classes.name: ItinerariesPageComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing user itineraries, including creation, listing, editing, and deletion.

methods.name: titleInvalid
methods.description: Checks if the itinerary title control is invalid and has been touched or dirtied.

methods.name: createItinerary
methods.description: Creates a new itinerary using form data if the form is valid.

methods.name: beginEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for a specific itinerary by setting the editingId and pendingTitle.

methods.name: cancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels the edit mode, resetting editing state and pending title.

methods.name: saveTitle
methods.description: Saves the updated title for an itinerary after trimming and validation.
